data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2018 the syndicate's gross claims outstanding were GBP 730.8m. The technical reserves increased through the year reflecting current year catastrophe losses and higher IBNR; reinsurers' share of claims outstanding also increased reflecting recoveries on catastrophe losses. The report does not provide a single explicit gross aggregate prior-year reserve movement figure in the movement note or managing agent narrative, so a quantified prior-year development (gross) cannot be reliably determined from the presented disclosures.
raw_causal_phrases: Reinsurers' share of claims outstanding as at 31 December 2018 is GBP 407.0m compared to GBP 330.8m as at the prior year. The increase in reinsurers' share of claims outstanding is primarily due to recoveries from the Syndicate's catastrophe losses in the year and increasing IBNR from the casualty and specialty quota share contracts in line with the growth in the underlying assumed book.

Gross technical provisions have increased to GBP 1,267.5m from GBP 967.6m. This includes an increase in unearned premiums and claims outstanding, principally as IBNR, attributed to increased gross premiums in the year. In addition, the claims outstanding also includes the reserves for the catastrophe losses incurred during the second half of the year.

The Syndicate's claims and claim expense reserves reflect its estimates, using actuarial and statistical projections at a given point in time, of the expectations of the ultimate settlement and administration costs of claims incurred.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken directly from the Claims Outstanding note (explicit). No explicit aggregated GROSS prior-year reserve movement figure (movement in prior year's provision) was located in the movement notes or managing agent narrative; therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m is null. A gross claims development triangle is present in the notes but was not programmatically reconciled to produce an aggregate prior-year movement for older underwriting years in this extraction.
